title: Graphilosophy: Graph-Based Digital Humanities Computing with The Four Books
reasoning: The paper is dedicated to the computational analysis of the Confucian 'Four Books,' which are foundational texts for East Asian ethical and philosophical systems. It specifically models core ethical concepts like benevolence (ren) and ritual propriety (li) and evaluates the system's ability to facilitate philosophical learning and preserve the nuanced moral discourse of these traditions.
